newsitem.title: UK: Granada up on hotel sale, ahead HY-figures.
newsitem.headline: Granada up on hotel sale, ahead HY-figures.

text.p: Shares in Granada Group Plc rose on Monday, after it announced the sale of its Brown's Hotel and amid speculation the hotel-to-leisure-group will deliver a better half-year result tomorrow, dealers said.
By 1110 GMT, the stock was up 14-1/2p to 892-1/2p.
"There are many stories affiliated with Granada at moment", a trader said. "But I guess the market believe in better figures", he added.
Granada is due to report its half-year results on Tuesday.
Apart the sale of the hotel, which earns Granada a premium of 5.6 million stg, renewed speculation about a bid for Yorkshire Television Plc would lure investors, a trader said.
